proposed_git_allowlist.purpose: current project overview and reading pointers
authoritative project state, accepted/in-progress checkpoints and object indexes
goals, dependencies, priority, actions and completion criteria
approved variants, approval provenance and pending questions
missing inputs, failed attempts, affected work and release criteria
verified module capabilities, unsupported behavior and code/test links
selected immutable source catalog
catalog counts and version
accepted milestones and explicitly pending progress
run/source/snapshot/reproduction relationships
all cost scenarios, yearly results, benchmarks, trading, limitations and validation
full versioned field dictionary
financial import provenance and partition references
financial audit and strict historical availability
frozen published state; no checkout writes to live Store
required terminal batch records and base chain
existing required snapshot metadata; missing objects explicitly marked
logical fingerprints, verified file SHA, payload scope and package references
validation, review, approval, failure and independent calculation references
bounded verified input/output cases with real/synthetic labels
actual generated plan/manifest/receipt and availability
current status page generated from metadata
short reading entry points, stable rules and terminology

proposed_git_allowlist.purpose: associated implementation, validation, configuration and environment

payload_exclusions: compressed handoff archives and raw PDF/image/HTML responses
implementation_steps: review associated untracked/modified code, docs and configs without reverting existing work
implement explicit Git allowlist and read-only metadata export/verify script
export current and last accepted project state, tasks, decisions, catalog, financial dictionary, runs and evidence; update short entry points and generated status page
register newly generated current payload bundles using existing prepare_handoff.py
verify Git-only reading, partial-payload refusal and one selected full offline reproduction
record local commit and remote synchronization separately after authorized publication

rules: source and configuration counts differ from run counts
research components and synthetic diagnostics do not count as trading backtests
summary availability does not prove complete original evidence availability
Store logical fingerprint differs from file byte SHA256
historical approvals persist within their stated scope
metadata checkout does not switch live Store publication
all factual suggestions cite repository evidence and disclose missing data
